json.reply: Boots, Inspector. Thank you. A hundred and twelve rooms in this house, a hundred and twelve keys on Herr Pell's board, and one brass hook between four and five with nothing on it and a name sanded off above it. I have dusted that hook for twenty-three years and never once been told what it is for.
